title: sonicetl ETL pipeline schema
description: The official ETL YAML schema consumed by the sonicetl native core. The root document is a list of pipelines; each pipeline declares named sources (file/duckdb URIs) and datasets. Each record is parsed natively (sonic-rs) and the declared field expressions streamed into typed columns: a parquet file/directory, an in-memory duckdb table, or a duckdb-file table. Datasets may LEFT JOIN against tables produced earlier in the same run_pipelines call.

execution.description: Optional scheduler plan (docs/scheduler.md). A list of stages run serially; each stage is a group of nodes run concurrently. Absent, every pipeline runs serially in declaration order.

group.description: Members of this stage's parallel group.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name to fan out / run.

partition.description: partition(source.field, N): split the source record universe into N partitions, one scheduler task per non-empty partition. Each task filters $.<field> IN $task.ctx.units.

uri.description: Store URI: file:///path (or bare path) for a JSON/parquet document, memory://<table> or duckdb://<file>?table=<t> for an existing table.

json_path.description: Optional sub-path of a JSON document (e.g. $.records).

format.description: Informational; parquet is the file default.

alias.description: Column prefix exposed to field expressions, e.g. mkt -> mkt.spot.

target.description: Store URI of the table to join against.

type.description: raw/master: one output row per input record. unwound: zero-or-more rows per record, driven by unwind_rules.

source.description: Default source (a Source.name); $ resolves to it.

filter.description: Optional boolean expression evaluated per output row; failing rows are dropped for this dataset (e.g. "$.name IN $task.ctx.units").

row_root.description: Assemble a new JSON root per output row from raw record ("$"), an unwind-rule alias, or the join alias; field expressions then address children (e.g. $.instrument.id, cast($.market.spot as double)).

expression.description: Field expression. See docs/schema.md for the grammar.

name.description: Rule identifier; also the alias fallback when output_alias is empty.

unwind_path.description: JSON path to an array, e.g. "$.underlyings".

output_alias.description: Alias under which each element is exposed to expressions, e.g. "u" -> "$.u".
